summary: Startup splash never shows on a first/cold run. main.js:751 logs ERR_FAILED (-2) loading app/splash/splash.html, but the file IS in the artifact - ERR_FAILED is what Electron raises when the WebContents is destroyed mid-navigation, not a missing file (that is ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND -6). Cross-platform and pre-existing per the user. Inverted behaviour: fails on the slow start it exists to cover, works warm. Candidates: main window ready-to-show firing on the error page and closing the splash at main.js:419-421, or the splash load being starved. Not fixed in 1.3.0 on purpose.
